sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.0.36
- Completely purged legacy Customer Wishlist Engine from codebase, assets, and admin settings
- Standardized multi-currency pricing and psychological rounding matrix (9_end, 90_end, 500_step, 50_step, none)
- Integrated multi-zone free shipping thresholds contract (/checkout/config) powering headless Free Shipping bars
- Exposed headless checkout endpoints under exacoat-core/v1 and exacoat/v1 namespaces
